title: CRESiST: Self-Enhancing Explorative Policy Learning for Simultaneous Speech Translation
summary: Replaces prefix-incremental generation and external Voice Activity Detection in simultaneous speech translation with an end-to-end interleaved read-write framework using an omni-modal LLM. Requires training an RNN-T Actor and LLM-based Critic, likely involving significant compute for policy distillation, and modifies the inference loop to handle unbounded streams. Infinite-length streaming stability and policy convergence may fail under distribution shift, and the Actor-Critic pipeline introduces training complexity compared to static alignment baselines.
rationale: The technique requires training a custom Actor-Critic policy and deploying an omni-modal LLM with specialized interleaved inference, which likely exceeds the reader's constrained infrastructure and limited cloud budget.
